scope: GitHub public-facing core documentation at main snapshot; not a complete Git history or institutional file audit

snapshot_review.limits: Manual contextual review of paths, metadata, screenshots, commits, PR comments, histories and institutional rights remains pending

checks.acceptance: Review context of references, PR diffs, comments, documents and attachments without reposting values
Confirm permission for lab metadata, technical screenshots and institutional references
Choose no-license/proprietary or license only after verifying authorship, third-party components and distribution rights
Review history, old branches, tags, attachments and potentially disclosed values privately; Gitleaks green alone is insufficient
Freeze exact main commit, checks and archive composition after other authorized PRs
Approve tag and source-only release explicitly; no snapshots, dumps, tokens, personal data or system images
